purpose: Fresh prospective audit-only comparison of whether adding H1 and then M5/H4 branches to canonical M15 N3 improves portfolio-level edge/frequency under one-position dedup, before introducing the separate M9R risk/reward overlays.

branch_definitions.S1_M5: M5 M7C-style PRIMARY/EXIT state machine; first causal M1 turn after a post-start PRIMARY; at turn decision own M5 relative core true (M5 tick_volume_ratio20 <= trailing200 q50 OR M5 MACD line bps >= trailing200 q75), latest closed M15 MACD line bps >= trailing100 q75, latest closed H1 MACD line bps >= trailing100 q50, latest closed H1 RCI9 >= trailing100 q50.
branch_definitions.S2_M15: Canonical M9P N3: M15 M7C-style state machine; first causal M1 turn after post-start PRIMARY; N1 latest closed M5 tick_volume_ratio20 <= trailing200 q50 OR N2 latest closed M15 MACD line bps >= trailing200 q75.
branch_definitions.S3_H1: H1 M7C-style state machine; first causal M1 turn after post-start PRIMARY; latest closed H4 MACD line bps >= trailing100 q75 AND latest closed D1 MACD line bps >= trailing100 q50.
branch_definitions.S4_H4: H4 M7C-style state machine; first causal M1 turn after post-start PRIMARY; latest closed D1 RCI9 >= trailing100 q50 AND D1 EMA20>EMA30>EMA40. Premium/reference branch only.

first_turn_contract.long_condition: previous M1 low <= minimum low of prior five-bar history, previous low < original proxy-primary signal bid/open, current closed M1 close > previous closed M1 close; virtual entry at next exact M1 open

portfolio_dedup.when_flat: accept the first eligible branch candidate chronologically
portfolio_dedup.while_active: do not open another GOLD LONG; record later eligible branch candidates as ordered confirmation metadata only
portfolio_dedup.accepted_trade_exit: use the accepted branch's own frozen timeframe proxy exit; no runner in M9V

fresh_start_bootstrap.state_rehydration: Historical closed bars may be replayed before start only to determine each timeframe state. Any ACTIVE position whose PRIMARY occurred before start is ineligible for M9V candidate accounting; wait for its proxy EXIT/return-to-IDLE before a new post-start PRIMARY becomes eligible.
fresh_start_bootstrap.start_freeze_rule: Initialize only after required live CSVs are current and stable; write immutable runtime manifest/start receipt before prospective rows are accepted.

reporting.confirmation_metadata: record ordered causal branch sequence and time gaps; do not convert to a positive score automatically
reporting.cost_reporting: historical/live spread where available; commission/swap remain separately labeled unless explicitly modeled

review_gates.note: These are review checkpoints, not statistical guarantees. H1 frequency is low, so branch-specific conclusions may require more evidence than the portfolio event gate.

m9r_relationship.policy: Do not add N6 half-risk or selective runner into M9V arms. First establish fresh multi-timeframe branch/portfolio behavior. Later test M9R as a separate portfolio-compatible risk/reward layer with its own explicit comparison.
